algorithm: Composite score 0-100 from causal entry features: ADX trend strength, ML confidence, inverted false-signal score, market context score, and trend-alignment flag. Calibrated against historical winner centroid. Reject signals below threshold.
risk: Moderate — reduces trade count; may miss tail winners in low-score band
reasoning: Winners show higher ADX, lower false-signal flags, better trend alignment, and stronger session context (Overlap/NY). Filter removes lowest-scoring ~15% without retraining ML.
